editorial.blurb: This hidden gem cafe near the Western Blue Line delivers generous, well-seasoned comfort food in a cozy family-run space with genuinely warm service.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the steak tacos with the house green sauce on the side—reviewers rave about the quality skirt steak and cilantro preparation, and arrive early on weekends to snag a seat in the compact but packed dining room.

topDishes.note: Exceptional skirt steak elevated by house green sauce—reviewers call them better than any taco shop
Generous ribeye, mushrooms, onions, melted cheeses and eggs served bubbling in cast iron
Sweet, decadent with blueberry sauce and powder sugar that reviewers loved enough to lick clean
